PP_CompatModeTip: For DS4 controllers that are not made by Sony: changes how the light and rumble are sent. Turn it on if the light does not change or turn off.
PP_PowerOffTip: Press this combo to turn off this controller at once. The game does not receive those buttons.
PP_PowerOffHint: Press it and the controller turns off at once. Bluetooth only (by USB, unplug the cable).
PPC_CloneCompatOn: Controller {0} looks non-original: compatible mode was turned on so the light works.
